import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    events = inputs["events"].copy()
    
    # Sort by user_id, event_ts, event_id
    events = events.sort_values(by=["user_id", "event_ts", "event_id"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Calculate time gap from previous event (within same user)
    events["prev_event_ts"] = events.groupby("user_id")["event_ts"].shift(1)
    
    # Calculate time difference in seconds
    events["time_gap_seconds"] = (events["event_ts"] - events["prev_event_ts"]).dt.total_seconds()
    
    # Mark new session: gap > 1800 seconds (30 minutes) or first event (NULL prev_event_ts)
    events["new_sess"] = ((events["time_gap_seconds"] > 1800) | (events["prev_event_ts"].isna())).astype(int)
    
    # Cumulative sum within each user to get session_num
    events["session_num"] = events.groupby("user_id")["new_sess"].cumsum()
    
    # Group by user_id and session_num to get session-level aggregates
    user_sessions = events.groupby(["user_id", "session_num"]).agg(
        session_start=("event_ts", "min"),
        session_end=("event_ts", "max"),
        event_count=("event_id", "count")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Ensure session_num is 1-based (it already is due to cumsum starting at 1 on first event)
    user_sessions = user_sessions.sort_values(by=["user_id", "session_num"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    
    return {"user_sessions": user_sessions}
